inputs.prompt: Epic cinematic shot, Chinese ancient northern frontier at dusk. Ultra-wide establishing view: a colossal ancient Chinese border fortress-city stands on the vast windswept desert steppe between barren yellow loess hills and distant mountains, the huge grey-and-vermilion city wall and battlements, war banners and flags torn by fierce wind, beacon towers blazing with columns of pitch smoke rising into the burning orange sunset sky. Sinking sun low on the horizon, long shadows, blowing sand and dust. The camera slowly pushes forward. Volumetric light, warm-cool color contrast, film color grade, real photographic texture, shallow depth of field, oppressive and stirring atmosphere of an impending great war. Then a fast close shot: a black war horse gallops at high speed through swirling yellow sand kicking up clouds of dust, the rider a young Chinese female general in dark heavy armor and a war helm, long black hair streaming in the wind, cold resolute expression, holding a long curved saber. Side tracking camera follows the horse at high speed then quickly pushes in on her determined eyes. Realistic horse motion, real skin and hair, real armor and cold weapons, cinematic film look, IMAX epic war cinema, 16:9. No audio - silent video.
